title: Broward County Clerk of Courts passport offices
fact: Central Courthouse, 201 S.E. 6th Street, Room 01160, Fort Lauderdale: Monday to Friday 7:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. North (Deerfield Beach), South (Hollywood) and West (Plantation) Regional Courthouses: Monday to Friday 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. Excluding holidays.

title: Palm Beach County Clerk passport services
fact: Appointment required: walk-in customers are not accepted. Appointments at Palm Beach Gardens, Delray Beach, Royal Palm Beach or Belle Glade. Passport photos $16 each.

title: Miami-Dade Public Library System passport services
fact: North Dade Regional, West Kendall Regional and Naranja Branch libraries accept passport applications by appointment only; one appointment per applicant. Photo service is currently not available.
